description: Read or update gitignored Dispatch settings: section order, standup notes, standing job instructions, Slack tracked channel ids, mention window and caps, max parallel jobs (default 4, admitted on free memory), in-process subagents, host fan-out, post-job verification, worker backend (auto = match this host, cursor, or claude), placement (checkout = your tree uncommitted, worktree = separate branch + commit), dispatchMode (ask = offer teammate-or-inline in one line before changing code, the default; auto = dispatch without asking; inline = only dispatch when the user asks for a job), hint policy, and whether the tickets slot is Linear or Jira. Any other wish works too: pass preference="…" to add a standing preference (applied to standup presentation), removePreference="…" to drop one; an unknown setting key is kept as a preference and said so, never silently dropped. Standing how-the-teammate-should-work notes are jobInstructions (injected into every job prompt); one-off facts still belong to remember. action=export returns a non-secret template (no tokens) for sharing. The Prism Console Dispatch Settings tab edits the same file.

dispatchMode.description: How the chat routes a code change: ask (default — offer teammate-or-inline in one line first), auto (dispatch without asking), or inline (only dispatch when the user asks for a job outright)

fanout.description: Split one brief into sibling jobs (default off; heavy)

includeMemories.description: When exporting, include opted-in user memories

jobInstructions.description: Standing how-to for every Dispatch job, injected into the worker prompt

placement.description: Where jobs work: checkout (default — your tree, uncommitted) or worktree (separate branch + commit)

preference.description: Add a standing free-form preference (e.g. 'standup: terse'). Applied to standup presentation.

removePreference.description: Drop standing preferences containing this text

standupTemplate.description: Standup notes pasted at the top of start my day

subagents.description: In-process subagents inside one teammate (default on)

verifyJobs.description: Run this repository's checks after a teammate stops

workerBackend.description: Which agent runs jobs: auto (match this host), cursor, or claude

name: configure
title: Configure Dispatch
